brief:
With one week until polling day, US President Trump endorsed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for re-election, Middle East Eye reported. The timing raised questions about whether Trump's backing would sway Israeli voters and what commitments Netanyahu might have made to secure the endorsement.

Netanyahu's campaign has faced scrutiny over the price of Trump's support. Analysts questioned whether the endorsement carried meaningful weight among Israeli voters or represented a symbolic gesture in a crowded political landscape ahead of the ballot.
dek: How far will Netanyahu go to win Israel's elections? With just a week until Israelis head to the polls, US President Trump has endorsed Netanyahu for re-election. But does his support mean anything to Israelis? And what has Netanyahu offered him in return?
title: Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of Israeli elections
